dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-grey annuli with jagged, high-contrast perimeters against dark brown base color. Edges show a sharp transition from dark to light with minimal feathering.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid dark circular clusters concentrated within the light interiors of the macro-annuli. Occasional high-intensity light-colored points are observed in the spaces between the rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent dorsal-lateral rings form an irregular, non-linear chain-like configuration following the spinal curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible foreflipper with five distinct, dark-toned elongated claws.
